title: NFLPARLAYCOMP — NFL Parlay Paper-Trading Competition
description: Auditable paper-trading competition in which simulated users run deterministic NFL strategy programs against Kalshi NFL markets, with no order-placement code and no credentials anywhere in the repository. State read from the committed files at commit fef877f, which superseded the head this directory rewrote the entry against 70 minutes earlier: 1,000 users, 500 trades, and a 500-line hash-chained ledger that verifies clean (chain valid, count 500, 0 errors). Every one of the 500 trades is EXECUTED and none has SETTLED — CANDIDATE, SIGNAL, ORDER, CLOSED, CANCELLED and REJECTED are all 0 — so no realized result exists yet, and the leaderboard says so plainly: total_pnl is 0.00 for all 1,000 users and win_rate is 0.00 for all 1,000. The bankrolls have nevertheless moved, and the two readings do not agree: sum(starting_bankroll) is 10,001,606.66 against sum(current_bankroll) of 9,919,682.37, a difference of -81,924.29 or -0.82 percent of the capital started, while the per-user total_pnl field that a reader would take for the result reads 0.00 everywhere. This directory publishes both and resolves neither (IRR-89). The strategy library is 52 programs across six categories (game-based 11, situational 11, market-based 10, prop-based 10, correlation 5, statistical 5), up from 37 at the previous head. verification_report.json, generated 2026-09-22T23:42:21Z, reports valid true with 577 UNVERIFIED_DATA flags and no MISSING_DATA flag at all: the market manifest it reported missing an hour earlier now exists, with 6 rows, 0 malformed and valid true. The repository still states that no verified market data has been collected — data/raw/ is absent from the committed tree — and each flag gives the reason per trade ('Market file missing for KXNFLGAME-26SEP21LVPHI, may be synthetic fixture'). The published site is still reached through a root index.html forwarder into docs/, now accompanied by a .nojekyll file at the root to stop Jekyll processing the legacy Pages build, and docs/site_data/ holds 1,057 files totalling 6.44 MB. The Kalshi fee schedule transcribed into the engine and asserted by its tests is unchanged across this range — no file under engine/ or tests/ was touched between 84f138f and fef877f — so the result executed at the previous head carries: Ran 103 tests, OK with 1 skipped, with scripts/test_all.py reporting all four gates passed. Taker fees round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)) and are charged at execution with no settlement fee, maker fees are M x 0.0175, the KXNFLGAME multiplier is 1, and NFL combos are maker 2 / taker 1.

The entry published for this repository earlier in the same audit pass was rewritten wholesale, and then rewritten a second time 70 minutes later. At 241d392 the same files reported 100 users, 35 strategies, 32 ledger trades (25 EXECUTED, 7 SETTLED), total PnL +135.04 and average ROI +0.02 percent, 12 unit tests and no root index.html. At 84f138f, eight commits later: 1,000 users, 37 strategies, 2,705 ledger lines, 1,623 trades (541 EXECUTED, 1,082 SETTLED), total PnL -92,876.56, 2,975 flags and a root forwarder that moved the classification from stub to app (IRR-82). At fef877f, four commits after that: 500 ledger lines, 500 trades all EXECUTED with 0 settled, per-user total_pnl 0.00 against an aggregate bankroll movement of -81,924.29, 577 flags, a manifest that now exists, and 52 strategies (IRR-89). Three states in one pass, and the ledger shrank by 2,205 lines between the second and third.

The published site is reached through a forwarder, which is why this entry classifies as app: root index.html is a 2,429-byte page that redirects to docs/ and explains in its own body that 'GitHub Pages for this repository is set to the legacy root-path build, so this forwarder is needed to reach docs/'. docs/OPERATIONS.md records that GET /repos/buffedlizard55-lab/NFLPARLAYCOMP/pages returns build_type legacy with source main /, that the workflow's artifact is therefore not what gets served, and that the intended switch to a GitHub Actions source fails because PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pages returns 403 Resource not accessible by integration for this project's token.

The competition is explicitly framed as a falsification exercise rather than a profit claim, and the repository deletes strategy-shaped statistics it cannot source: where an earlier draft cited an edge versus the closing line, a '57% under rate' or a '62% fade win rate', the number has been removed and the strategy now records 'Evidence: none established in this repository'. Several strategies are retained as falsification targets whose documented premise contradicts their implementation — STRAT_PRIMETIME_FAVE_015 buys the underdog moneyline while citing a spread-cover statistic, and STRAT_LIQUIDITY_033 models resting maker behaviour but is priced and charged as a taker — and both are present in engine/strategies.py at this commit.

Two measured size claims in the README do not quite match the committed bundles, and the gap moved in this range. The README says site output at 1,000 users is '~6.8 MB across ~1,050 files'; walking docs/site_data/ at fef877f counts 1,057 files totalling 6.44 MB of actual bytes, where the same walk at 84f138f counted 1,052 files and 7.62 MB. The file count agrees with the approximation to within 7 files; the byte total was 12 percent above it an hour ago and is 5 percent below it now, which is recorded rather than smoothed over.

Execution realism is disclosed rather than assumed: buying YES pays the YES ask and buying NO pays 1 minus the yes_bid, so crossing the spread is not charged again as slippage; with a verified order-book snapshot the order walks real levels and slippage_vs_best is measured, but without one the fill is modelled at top of book and flagged ORDERBOOK_MISSING — and no snapshots exist in this checkout. Orders larger than resting depth are partially filled and orders above 50 percent of traded liquidity are rejected as unexecutable.
